title: Prove exact internal rounding for one P104 collector
body:
## Summary

PR2730 leaves internal rounding open for its mixed-grid P104 collector. This supplies an exact in-place integer kernel for its two actual rank-seven native recipes. Four extra fractional bits suffice after every binary butterfly, with exact dirty-state restoration and private erasure. The uniform guards 0 through 3 fail on an explicit input.

```text
five h-grid sources -> S -> internally rounded U -> fine-grid query write
                         -> internally rounded V -> S -> exact zero cleanup
```

The source-bound package adds the all-prefix proof, complete finite arithmetic/storage bill, pinned immutable inputs and a registered replay. The actual return prefixes need 4,3,3,2,2,1,1,0 extra bits; arbitrary fine-grid return inputs are excluded. The general Gaussian denominator rules remain credited prior work.

## Evidence

- Before: PR2730's first open question asks for an internal implementation. With guard 3, the literal kernel leaves `-h e_0` at cleanup.
- After: guard 4 preserves all 9,216 correlated prefix columns and exact cleanup. Both native maps also match 1,024 closed-form columns, and the in-place implementation matches every forward/return endpoint.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay and six package tests pass. Independent Fraction arithmetic, source/receipt corruption, optimized Git-free replay and semantic failure controls pass. All 70 research-workflow tests pass with three skips. CPython 3.14.8 package tests and warning-enabled compilation pass. Separate local review independently reconstructed the full prefix census.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-internal-grid-collector
```

Scientific base main `34588a98dabb668d4c53e5e776cd7b3927174d26`, priority revision 5. Canonical main was refreshed before submission; current guidance, selected record and replay dependencies are unchanged. Task and overlap coverage are recorded in TASK.json. [Canonical investigation and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750).

Credit ywz65/PR2730 and PR2586, Arham Tahir/PR2665, Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales's Gaussian parity work, and the retained physical/native/P104 lineage. Exact source pins and predecessor notices are preserved.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one research package.

Only `research/p104-internal-grid-collector/` is added. The finite scalar kernel does not establish recursive-child cost, rounded-prefix entrance grids, query-consumer admission, physical hosting, a complete supplier, full multiplication theorem or a new kappa. Physical compiler correctness is inherited. CPython allocations are distinguished from the bounded microprogram storage bill. No hosted-CI or independent-human verification is claimed; the selected frontier is unchanged.
